description: This file defines the DisplayUtils class, a utility class providing various static methods for UI-related operations within an Android app, such as converting categories to navigation items, detecting soft keyboard visibility, starting link intents, and displaying snack messages.

classes.name: DisplayUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for UI operations in an Android app, such as converting categories to navigation items, detecting keyboard visibility, starting URL intents, and showing snackbars.

methods.name: convertToCategoryNavigationItem
methods.description: Converts a collection of CategoryWithNotesCount objects into a list of CategoryNavigationItem objects for displaying categories in the app.

methods.name: convertToCategoryNavigationItem
methods.description: Converts a single CategoryWithNotesCount object into a CategoryNavigationItem, determining the appropriate icon based on category name and predefined replacements.

methods.name: getEnglishResources
methods.description: Creates and returns a Resources object with English locale settings for comparison purposes.

methods.name: isSoftKeyboardVisible
methods.description: Detects whether the soft keyboard is currently visible, using appropriate methods depending on API level.

methods.name: startLinkIntent
methods.description: Overloaded methods to initiate an intent to open a URL or URI, handling cases where no suitable app is available.

methods.name: startIntentIfAppAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an intent can be handled by any installed app, and if so, starts it; otherwise shows an error message.

methods.name: showSnackMessage
methods.description: Displays a Snackbar message, either with a string resource ID or a direct string, bound to either a view or the activity's content view.
